thag19.1:1.1: Cattālīsanipāto samatto. PAÑÑĀSANIPĀTO. Kadā nu 'haṃ pabbatakandarāsu ekākiyo addutiyo vihassaṃ aniccato sabbabhavaṃ vipassaṃ, taṃ me idaṃ taṃ nu kadā bhavissati. || ||
thag19.1:2.1: kadā nu 'haṃ bhinnapaṭandharo muni kāsāvavattho amamo nirāsayo rāgañ ca dosañ ca tath' eva mohaṃ hantvā sukhī pavanagato vihassaṃ. || ||
thag19.1:3.1: kadā aniccaṃ vadharoganīḷaṃ kāyaṃ imaṃ maccujarāy' upaddutaṃ vipassamāno vītabhayo vihassaṃ eko vane, taṃ nu kadā bhavissati. || ||
thag19.1:4.1: kadā nu 'haṃ bhayajananiṃ dukkhāvahaṃ taṇhālataṃ bahuvidhānuvattaniṃ paññāmayaṃ tikhiṇaṃ asiṃ gahetvā chetvā vase, tam pi kadā bhavissati. || ||
thag19.1:5.1: kadā nu paññāmayam uggatejaṃ satthaṃ isīnaṃ sahasādiyitvā Māraṃ sasenaṃ sahasā bhañjissaṃ sīhāsane, taṃ nu kadā bhavissati. || ||
thag19.1:6.1: kadā nu 'haṃ sabbhi samāgamesu diṭṭho bhave dhammagarūhi tādihi yathāvadassīhi jitindriyehi padhāniyo, taṃ nu kadā bhavissati. || ||
thag19.1:7.1: kadā nu maṃ tandikhudāpipāsā vātātapā kīṭasiriṃsapā vā nibādhayissanti na taṃ Giribbaje attatthiyaṃ, taṃ nu kadā bhavissati. || ||
thag19.1:8.1: kadā nu kho yaṃ viditaṃ mahesinā cattāri saccāni sududdasāni samāhitatto satimā agacchaṃ paññāya taṃ, taṃ nu kadā bhavissati. || ||
thag19.1:9.1: kadā nu rūpe amite ca sadde gandhe rase phusitabbe ca dhamme ādittato 'haṃ samathehi yutto paññāya dakkhaṃ, tad idaṃ kadā me. || ||
thag19.1:10.1: kadā nu 'haṃ dubbacanena vutto tatonimittaṃ vimano na hessaṃ, atho pasaṭṭho pi tatonimittaṃ tuṭṭho na hessaṃ, tad idaṃ kadā me. || ||
thag19.1:11.1: kadā nu kaṭṭhe ca tiṇe latā ca khandhe ime 'haṃ anite ca dhamme ajjhattikān' eva ca bāhirāni ca samaṃ tuleyyaṃ, tad idaṃ kadā me. || ||
thag19.1:12.1: kadā nu maṃ pāvusakālamegho navena toyena sacīvaraṃ vane isippayātamhi pathe vajantaṃ ovassate, taṃ nu kadā bhavissati. || ||
thag19.1:13.1: kadā mayūrassa sikhaṇḍino vane dijassa sutvā girigabbhare rutaṃ paccuṭṭhahitā amatassa pattiyā saṃcintaye, taṃ nu kadā bhavissati. || ||
thag19.1:14.1: kadā nu Gaṅgaṃ Yamunaṃ Sarassatiṃ pātālakhittaṃ baḷavāmukhañ ca asajjamāno patareyyam iddhiyā vibhiṃsanaṃ, taṃ nu kadā bhavissati. || ||
thag19.1:15.1: kadā nu nāgo va saṃgāmacārī padālaye kāmaguṇesu chandaṃ nibbajjayaṃ sabbasubhaṃ nimittaṃ jhāne yuto, taṃ nu kadā bhavissati. || ||
thag19.1:16.1: kadā iṇaṭṭo va daḷiddako nidhiṃ ārādhayitvā dhanikehi pīḷito tuṭṭho bhavissaṃ adhigamma sāsanaṃ mahesino, taṃ nu kadā bhavissati. || ||
thag19.1:17.1: bahūni vassāni tayāmhi yācito: agāravāsena alaṃ nu te idaṃ; taṃ dāni maṃ pabbajitaṃ samānaṃ kiṃkāraṇaṃ citta tuvaṃ na yuñjasi. || ||
thag19.1:18.1: nanu ahaṃ citta tayāmhi yācito: Giribbaje citrachadā vihaṃgamā mahindaghosatthanitābhigajjino te taṃ ramissanti vanamhi jhāyinaṃ. || ||
thag19.1:19.1: kulamhi mitte ca piye ca ñātake khiḍḍāratiṃ kāmaguṇañ ca loke sabbaṃ pahāya idam ajjhupāgato, atho pi tvaṃ citta na mayha tussasi. || ||
thag19.1:20.1: mam' eva etaṃ, na hi taṃ paresaṃ; sannāhakāle paridevitena kiṃ. sabbam idaṃ calaṃ iti pekkhamāno abhinikkhamiṃ amataṃ padaṃ jigīsaṃ. || ||
thag19.1:21.1: suvuttavādī dvipadānam uttamo mahābhisakko naradammasārathi: cittaṃ calaṃ makkaṭasannibhaṃ iti avītarāgena sudunnivāriyaṃ. || ||
thag19.1:22.1: kāmā hi citrā madhurā manoramā aviddasū yattha sitā puthujjanā, te dukkham icchanti punabbhavesino cittena nītā niraye niraṃkatā. || ||
thag19.1:23.1: mayūrakoñcābhirudamhi kānane dīpīhi byagghehi purakkhato vasaṃ kāye apekkhaṃ jaha mā virāye, iti ssu maṃ citta pure niyuñjasi. || ||
thag19.1:24.1: bhāvehi jhānāni ca indriyāni ca balāni bojjhaṅgasamādhibhāvanā tisso ca vijjā phusa buddhasāsane, iti ssu maṃ citta pure niyuñjasi. || ||
thag19.1:25.1: bhāvehi maggaṃ amatassa pattiyā niyyānikaṃ sabbadukhakkhayogadhaṃ atthaṅgikaṃ sabbakilesasodhanaṃ, iti ssu . . . || || dukkhan ti khandhe paṭipassa
thag19.1:26.1: yoniso, yato ca dukkhaṃ samudeti taṃ jaha, idh' eva dukkhassa karohi antaṃ, iti ssu . . . || || aniccaṃ dukkhan
thag19.1:27.1: ti vipassa yoniso suññaṃ anattā 'ti aghaṃ vadhan ti ca, manovicāre uparundha cetaso, iti ssu . . . || || muṇḍo virūpo abhisāpam
thag19.1:28.1: āgato kapālahattho 'va kulesu bhikkhasu, yuñjassu satthu vacane mahesino, iti ssu . . . || || susaṃvutatto
thag19.1:29.1: visikhantaraṃ caraṃ kulesu kāmesu asaṅgamānaso cando yathā dosinapuṇṇamāsiyā, iti ssu . . . || || āraññiko hoti ca piṇḍapātiko,
thag19.1:30.1: sosāniko hoti ca paṃsukūliko, nesajjiko hoti sadā dhute rato, iti ssu . . . || || ropetvā rukkhāni
thag19.1:31.1: yathā phalesī mūle taruṃ chettu tam eva icchasi, tath' ūpamaṃ citta idaṃ karosi yaṃ maṃ aniccamhi cale niyuñjasi. || ||
thag19.1:32.1: arūpa dūraṃgama ekacāri na te karissaṃ vacanaṃ idāni 'haṃ, dukkhā hi kāmā kaṭukā mahabbhayā, nibbānam evābhimano carissaṃ. || ||
thag19.1:33.1: nāhaṃ alakkhyā ahirīkatāya vā na cittahetū na ca dūrakantanā ājīvahetū ca ahaṃ na nikkhamiṃ, kato ca te citta paṭissavo mayā. || ||
thag19.1:34.1: appicchatā sappurisehi vaṇṇitā makkhappahānaṃ vūpasamo dukkhassa: iti ssu maṃ citta tadā niyuñjasi, idāni tvaṃ gacchasi pubbaciṇṇaṃ. || ||
thag19.1:35.1: taṇhaṃ avijjañ ca piyāpiyañ ca subhāni rūpāni sukhā ca vedanā manāpiyā kāmaguṇā ca vantā, vante ahaṃ āgamituṃ na ussahe. || ||
thag19.1:36.1: sabbattha te citta vaco kataṃ mayā, bahūsu, jātīsu na me 'si kopito, ajjhattasambhavo kataññutāya te, dukkhe ciraṃ saṃsaritaṃ tayā kate. || ||
thag19.1:37.1: tvañ ñeva no citta karosi brāhmaṇo tvaṃ khattiyā rājadisī karosi, vessā ca suddā ca bhavāma ekadā, devattanaṃ vāpi tav' eva vāhasā. || ||
thag19.1:38.1: tav' eva hetū asurā bhavāmase, tvaṃmūlakaṃ nerayikā bhavāmase, atho tiracchānagatāpi ekadā, petattanaṃ vāpi tav' eva vāhasā. || ||
thag19.1:39.1: na nūna dubbhissasi maṃ punappunaṃ muhuṃ muhuṃ vāraṇikaṃ va dassahaṃ; ummattaken' eva mayā palobhasi; kiñ cāpi te citta virādhitaṃ mayā.
thag19.1:41.1: satthā ca me lokam imaṃ adhiṭṭhahi aniccato addhuvato asārato; pakkhanda maṃ citta jinassa sāsane, tārehi oghā mahato suduttarā. || ||
thag19.1:42.1: na te idaṃ citta yathāpurāṇakaṃ, nāhaṃ alaṃ tuyha vase nivattituṃ; mahesino pabbajito 'mhi sāsane; na mādisā honti vināsadhārino. || ||
thag19.1:43.1: nagā samuddā saritā vasundharā disā catasso vidisā adhodisā sabbe aniccā tibhavā upaddutā, kuhiṃ gato citta sukhaṃ ramissasi. || ||
thag19.1:44.1: dhī dhī paraṃ kiṃ mama citta kāhasi; na te alaṃ citta vasānuvattako. na jātu bhastaṃ dubhato mukhaṃ chupe; dhir atthu pūraṃ navasotasandani. || || varāhaeṇeyyavigāḷhasevite
thag19.1:45.1: pabbhārakūṭe pakaṭe 'va sundare navambunā pāvusasittakānane tahiṃ guhāgehagato ramissasi. || ||
thag19.1:46.1: sunīlagīvā susikhā supekhuṇā sucittapattacchadanā vihaṃgamā sumañjughosatthanitābhigajjino te taṃ ramissanti vanamhi jhāyinaṃ. || ||
thag19.1:47.1: vuṭṭhamhi deve caturaṅgule tiṇe sampupphite meghanibhamhi kānane nagantare viṭapisamo sayissaṃ, taṃ me mudu hohiti tūlasannibhaṃ. || ||
thag19.1:48.1: tathā tu kassāmi yathāpi issaro; yaṃ labbhatī tena pi hotu me alaṃ; taṃ taṃ karissāmi yathā atandito biḷārabhastaṃ va yathā sumadditaṃ. || ||
thag19.1:49.1: tathā tu kassāmi yathāpi issaro; yaṃ labbhatī tena pi hotu me alaṃ; viriyena taṃ mayha vas' ānayissaṃ gajaṃ va mattaṃ kusalaṅkusaggaho. || ||
thag19.1:50.1: tayā sudantena avaṭṭhitena hi hayena yoggācariyo va ujjunā pahomi maggaṃ paṭipajjituṃ sivaṃ cittānurakkhīhi sadā nisevitaṃ. || ||
thag19.1:51.1: ārammaṇe taṃ balasā nibandhisaṃ nāgaṃ va thambhamhi daḷhāya rajjuyā, taṃ me suguttaṃ satiyā subhāvitaṃ anissitaṃ sabbabhavesu hehisi. || ||
thag19.1:52.1: paññāya chetvā vipathānusārinaṃ yogena niggayha pathe nivesiya disvā samudayaṃ vibhavañ ca sambhavaṃ dāyādako hehisi aggavādino. || ||
thag19.1:53.1: catubbipallāsavasaṃ adhiṭṭhitaṃ gāmaṇḍalaṃ va parinesi citta maṃ nanu saññojanabandhanacchidaṃ saṃsevase kāruṇikaṃ mahāmuniṃ. || ||
thag19.1:54.1: migo yathā seri sucittakānane rammaṃ giriṃ pāvisi abbhaḷ mālinaṃ, anākule tattha nage ramissasi, asaṃsayaṃ citta parābhavissasi. || ||
thag19.1:55.1: ye tuyha chandena vasena vattino narā ca nārī ca anubhonti yaṃ sukhaṃ, aviddasū Māravasānuvattino bhavābhinandī tava citta sevakā 'ti. || || Tālapuṭo thero. uddānaṃ: Paññāsamhi nipātamhi
thag19.1:56.0: eko Tālapuṭo suci, gāthāyo tattha paññāsa puna pañca ca uttarīti.
